text.p: Planet Hollywood International Inc said Friday it strengthened its senior management with the appointment of two executives, effective February 1, 1997.
Brian Woods, 37, joins the company in a newly created position, as president of the Planet Hollywood brand and related operating divisions, the company said.

He is responsible for the continued development of the Planet Hollywood brand, its franchising and licensing, as well as day-to-day operational management and expansion of its restaurant-merchandise and retail stores, the company said.
Ian Hamilton, 40, joins the company in a newly created position, as president of the Official All Star Cafe brand and related operating divisions, the company said.

He is responsible for continuing development of the emerging Official All Star Cafe brand, its ongoing franchising, development of licensing opportunities, and the day-to-day management and expansion of its restaurant-merchandise stores, the company said.
